leads.claim: ATIC initiated a program to distribute cameras to radar sites and control towers to capture imagery of UFOB activity.
leads.why: The mention of cameras and diffraction gratings refers to standard observational equipment for documenting sightings, not the recovery or custody of physical UAP material.

doc_verdict: This document contains no information suggesting the government or its contractors obtained, held, or analyzed physical UAP material; it is strictly an administrative summary of Project Bluebook's organizational status and observational efforts.
